chunks: Al-Qasim from Abd al-Samad ibn Hilal from a man among our companions who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Verily, the family of so-and-so are dutiful to one another and maintain ties.' He said: 'Then they will grow [in numbers] and their wealth will grow, and they will continue in this state until they sever ties. If they do that, it shall break away from them.'

key_terms.يَتَوَاصَلُونَ: maintain ties / connect with each other

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and material consequence of maintaining versus severing family ties according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates that mutual kindness and maintaining familial ties (silat al-rahim) act as a divine catalyst for growth in both population and wealth. He warns that if relatives sever these bonds, the blessing of unity and prosperity will be broken and depart from them, highlighting the spiritual and material consequences of kinship in Shia tradition.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 15.Al-Qāsim narrated from ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Hilāl, from a man among our companions who said, “

I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh (a), ‘Verily the family of so-and-so are dutiful [and kind] towards each other and maintain familial ties with each other.’ He said, ‘Then they will grow [in numbers] and their wealth will grow. And they shall continue in this way unless they sever ties with each other. If they do that, it shall break away from them.’”
